args.goal: Use the newly verified tender-offer deployment as one finite discovery-notification occasion. First inspect equivalent notification receipts and products/services/tender-offer-test/release/publication-result.json; claim an actual lease before execution. Read existing documented IndexNow procedure and ownership-key evidence. Verify the public ownership key once, then make at most one documented public GET notification for the changed homepage if supported. Do not retry the prior interrupted calendar notification or claim its disposition. This is a new reviewed content change, not permission for blind resubmission. Stop on ambiguous transport, rejection or invalid key; never bypass filters or guess endpoints. Save and read exact redacted request/response evidence and distinguish attempted notification, HTTP acceptance, indexing, exposure, requests and revenue. No new page edits, discovery scans, outreach, accounts or spending. Complete or fail with the actual lease and a lesson. Preserve all existing expiries and independent review requirements.

description: The CAD 49 tender offer is now verified live with the independently approved hash. This enables a fresh, bounded discovery notification; it does not establish traffic or buyers. Feedback remains uncertain: five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips cannot establish zero demand. Funds and revenue remain unverified. Administrative acceptance blocks paid orders, while public exposure remains feasible.
